## RateLimitedError class

The caller exceeded its admission limit, so the call was turned away before any authorization decision and did not run. Admission never grants anything: an admitted call is still subject to every later check.

**Signature:**

```typescript
declare class RateLimitedError extends MactsError<'RATE_LIMITED'>
```

**Extends:** [MactsError](./contracts.mactserror.md)<!-- -->&lt;'RATE_LIMITED'&gt;
